questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the past perfect tense?
options: She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
questions.answer: She said she had been to London before she moved there.

questions.question: Which option correctly completes the sentence with the present perfect continuous?
options: I _____ a lot of books since I started working at the library.
I _____ a lot of books since I started working at the library.
I _____ a lot of books since I started working at the library.
I _____ a lot of books since I started working at the library.
questions.answer: I have been reading a lot of books since I started working at the library.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
options: This hotel is more expensive than that one.
This hotel is more expensive than that one.
This hotel is more expensive than that one.
This hotel is more expensive than that one.
questions.answer: This hotel is more expensive than that one.

questions.question: Which conditional sentence is correctly formed?
options: If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
questions.answer: If it rains, the match will be cancelled.

questions.question: Select the correct modal verb for the situation.
options: You must finish your homework by tomorrow.
You must finish your homework by tomorrow.
You must finish your homework by tomorrow.
You must finish your homework by tomorrow.
questions.answer: You must finish your homework by tomorrow.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses the gerund or infinitive?
options: I enjoy painting in my free time.
I enjoy painting in my free time.
I enjoy painting in my free time.
I enjoy painting in my free time.
questions.answer: I enjoy painting in my free time.

questions.question: Choose the best linker to complete the sentence.
options: She is very tired, but she still wants to go out.
She is very tired, but she still wants to go out.
She is very tired, but she still wants to go out.
She is very tired, but she still wants to go out.
questions.answer: She is very tired, but she still wants to go out.

questions.question: Which word best completes the sentence about B1-level vocabulary?
options: The discovery of penicillin was a _____ in medical history.
The discovery of penicillin was a _____ in medical history.
The discovery of penicillin was a _____ in medical history.
The discovery of penicillin was a _____ in medical history.
questions.answer: The discovery of penicillin was a breakthrough in medical history.

questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in the past participle.
options: They have already _____ the project.
They have already _____ the project.
They have already _____ the project.
They have already _____ the project.
questions.answer: They have already completed the project.

questions.question: Select the appropriate word to complete the sentence.
options: Despite the rain, the children _____ playing in the park.
Despite the rain, the children _____ playing in the park.
Despite the rain, the children _____ playing in the park.
Despite the rain, the children _____ playing in the park.
questions.answer: Despite the rain, the children continued playing in the park.
